source: Natural Earth1:10m populated places, full dataset

freshFetchAndCheckPowerShell: if ((Get-FileHash -LiteralPath $placeArchive -Algorithm SHA256).Hash.ToLowerInvariant() -ne 'cd149186f03d2603e0410da399b980a4357d0ac32d3a2305a49ed3dffcc41d7b') { throw 'Natural Earth source hash mismatch' }
generation.bootstrap: The checked-in catalog supplies the original six-field rows. Its protected tuple hash is verified before any alias generation; a separate base-catalog input, existing TEMP file or record-position guess is not needed.

matching.rule: Exact NAME, ADM1NAME, ADM0NAME, population and actual SHP geometry rounded6→4decimals; no nearest-coordinate or row-order join. All first six existing values and their order are retained.
matching.dbfGeometryAssociation: Point SHP record number aligns with its DBF attribute record by the shapefile format. Catalog association is then an exact tuple join, not that record position.
matching.geometryNote: DBF LATITUDE/LONGITUDE can differ from actual SHP points and are not used to match or move catalog coordinates.

aliases.policy: Publisher strings retained verbatim after DBF padding trim, exact-string duplicates and the primary name omitted. Missing-value -99/null sentinels are omitted; control characters fail generation. No generated translations, transliterations, folding, country/admin aliases or punctuation splitting. Compound NAMEALT remains one publisher string.
